conference_consistency: passed: per-instance IR outcomes and optima; Compact-Base formula identity
time_rss_rule: median of available OPTIMAL runs per OPTIMAL instance; otherwise all three runs; then median over instances
outcome_rule: OPT if at least one repetition proves optimality; UNSAT if proven; otherwise TIMEOUT
paired_runtime_rule: all three repetitions OPTIMAL in both encodings

runtime_environment_sensitivity.eligibility: both encodings prove optimality in all three repetitions, as in Figure 4
runtime_environment_sensitivity.pairing: same instance SHA-256 and repetition; all matching fields present and equal
runtime_environment_sensitivity.aggregation: median runtime per encoding and instance using the retained pairs, then median Base/Objective ratio across instances
runtime_environment_sensitivity.interpretation: descriptive sensitivity analysis of recorded runs; equal recorded metadata does not control unrecorded execution conditions

PAR2_rule: penalize each run before taking the per-instance median, then average instances

objective_priority_comparison.selection: lowest-numbered OPTIMAL repetition; IR-IS single run, IR and IR-IM-IS three runs
